programs.description: Ganesh, a young man, is forced to pretend to be in love with Divya. However, trouble ensues when he truly starts liking her and must convince her of his feelings.
Nathan, a reclusive economist, is drawn into an emotionally charged relationship with Deepthi, a married woman whose sincerity disrupts his carefully detached world.
When his car breaks down on the way to Chennai, Nanda hitchhikes with Arjun, who is driving alone. However, their conversation takes a turn when Arjun proposes a deal to Nanda.
A village man and his friends find out that the local bank wants to seize the house of one of them. So, they resort to various means to stop their friend from being homeless.
After learning that his father lost all his wealth due to the wrongdoing of a cunning businessman, his son, Abhiram, seeks revenge.
Arjun Reddy Deshmukh, a young surgeon with functioning alcoholism and a furious temper, spirals into self-destruction when he learns that his girlfriend is marrying another man.
Vasu, a doctor, rescues KK, a criminal, from getting murdered in the hospital. However, when Vasu's wife gets kidnapped, he is asked to get KK out in exchange for his wife's safe return.
A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.
Swapna, a game designer, lives alone with her housemaid. However, her life turns upside down after a serial killer enters her house.
A magistrate recovering from trauma is drawn to a boy whose eerie murder stories match real crimes. As he investigates, shocking truths unfold, pulling him into a web of mystery and suspense.

Two rival artists at Sivadas Swamigal's drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.
After a young woman's romantic elopement turns sour, a selfish man motivated by greed decides to take her back home. But he realises the error of his ways and tries to protect her from her father.
In the eerie townscape of Chanderi, dressmaker Vicky falls for a mysterious woman with a supernatural aura. His heart sinks at the possibility that she might be Stree, the resentful man-hunter.
Martin uses a tracking app on his wife Leena's mobile. However, their relationship begins to suffer when hidden truths come to light.
Afraid of his disapproving father, a boy decides to elope with the girl he loves. Afraid of a greater wrath from his father, the boy's brother tries to convince them to wait.
Shiva and Indhu, two college students, are in love. However, Indhu's parents oppose their relationship and give her a book to read that may change her opinion of love.
Mohini and Harsha relocate to a different city to escape the haunting of an evil spirit only to later realize that the spirit is still hot on their trail.
Raghava, the head cook in a catering unit, leads a peaceful life with his son Arjun. However, their bliss is short-lived as Raghava's past comes back to haunt him.
A dishonest lawyer takes on a notorious client. However, the case puts him against his morally-minded father, an ex-judge with a past of his own.

Raja pretends to be a cop in order to impress the woman he loves, and she dumps him on learning the truth. When they meet again, he has a good job, but there is someone else who is in love with him.
Driven by unrelenting ambition, Nani sets out on a transformative quest to the Himalayas, compelled by the tragic loss of his childhood friend and a series of daunting challenges.
After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.
A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.
Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.
Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.
Friends Elango and Pulivetti stumble upon a time machine and exploit it for personal gain. Things take a turn when they alter a gangster's fate, leading to unforeseen and dangerous consequences.
Pradeep's life turns upside down when he is accused of a murder after discovering the dead body of an influential villager along with some precious jewels.
Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

Santhana Lakshmi is released from jail and finds herself reminiscing about her traumatic past as she attempts to figure out what she will do next.
Depressed with the constant failures in his personal and professional life, Vijay is in search of an opportunity to prove himself. While no one believes him, Swecha decides to give him a chance.

Karthik, raised in the slums by his brother, is an engineering student who was abandoned years ago by their father, Jothi. However, his life takes a drastic turn when Jothi exploits Karthik's friend for a drug-peddling assignment.
Chitti works for Jothi, a powerful drug lord, and is busy expanding his business and criminal activities. Unfortunately, his trusted assistant, Shiva, has other plans for him.
While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.
A constable's life takes a turn when a gruesome murder-cum-robbery takes place while he is on duty. To make matters worse, the deceased was a notorious gangster's brother, who is now out for revenge.
Confused between lust and love, a modern couple in a live-in relationship faces several hurdles as they struggle through pregnancy dilemmas and familial issues.
After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.
Surya, an IT professional, is wrongly accused in a high-profile murder case and spends years enduring abuse and languishing in prison waiting for his trial.

Suri, a young truck driver struggling with respiratory issues, lives with his caring father, Sampath. However, their relationship takes a turn when Suri falls in love with the Sarpanch's daughter.
Arjun Reddy Deshmukh, a young surgeon with functioning alcoholism and a furious temper, spirals into self-destruction when he learns that his girlfriend is marrying another man.
After seven years in prison for a crime he did not commit, gambler Jake Green enters into a game with potentially deadly consequences.
Freshmen at an engineering college bond after being picked on by seniors, eventually pairing into couples over their four years at school.
After losing his family, Sanjeev embarks on a journey of revenge, uncovering a deadly secret with Shruti's aid and confronting Raghupathi, who holds the key to the formula's destructive power.
The home minister asks Tirupathi to impersonate the deceased ACP Baldev, his lookalike, to catch Ganguly, a dreaded gangster. After taking over his new role, he finds many startling revelations.
In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.
An ambitious young man dreams of joining the police force and serving his nation. However, circumstances compel him to rebel and join a gang of notorious criminals.
Unruly Bergman is expelled from his seminary when a kind-hearted fellow student, Sam, exposes his heinous acts. Soon he resolves to teach Sam a lesson that evil does predominate supreme.

Satya, an investigating officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges to solve the murder case of a businessman's wife.
Madhu, traumatised by the sudden deaths of his father and girlfriend, tries to commit suicide, but is rescued by a stranger who looks exactly like him and transported to a distant planet.
Vasant finds out that his grandfather has found a prospective bride for him. However, in order to escape the situation, he must find a girl for himself within 30 days.
Robert, Dony and Xavier grow up together while honing their fighting skills. However, after an incident separates them for several years, an attack on their family reunites the three friends.
Shiva, struggling to find a decent job, finally takes up the job of a cab driver. However, things take an eerie and spooky turn when mysterious deaths start happening in the cab.
Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. However, when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.
Dinesh circulates an MMS of his neighbour Aarti's private moments. When a furious Aarti threatens to report him, it sets into motion a game of love, deceit and betrayal.
A few henchmen attack an African village to acquire a special artefact. While Akhil, a young and carefree orphan, thinks he has a connection with it and joins them.
Balu, an orphan, grows up to transform his childhood loneliness into a lifelong mission of nurturing love in others' lives.

Krish weaves up a love story between him and Meenu to make a rich girl, Manju, fall for him. However, trouble begins when he realises that he has developed feelings for Meenu.
After his post-graduate studies, Karthik takes a holiday in Europe. On his return journey, he falls in love at first sight with Nandana, and goes to great lengths to win her heart.
A boy and a girl, who want to earn quick money, meet and decide to con people for a living. Things change when a politician that they are blackmailing decides to settle scores.
Aditya, a lively young man, falls for Varsha, an introvert. Though she harbours similar feelings for him, she hesitates to confess, leading them to drift apart, only to cross paths years later.
Prabhu's life turns upside down when Dr Kannadasan, the owner of a fertility clinic, approaches him to become a sperm donor.
Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly in their pursuit of making quick money. Soon after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.
Nani, a middle-class boy with an eidetic memory, helps save his sister-in-law from a goon. Meanwhile, he also tries to convince his girlfriend's father to marry her off to him.
A 57-year-old retired officer in the Chennai crime branch goes to Seattle to reunite with his estranged son. However, a missing case in his son's neighbourhood prompts him to start an investigation.
A young woman, Vennela, in love with a widely discreet revolutionary, Ravi Shankar, invites trouble after she breaks her marriage and follows her heart to reunite with the person she loves.

An honest policeman is transferred to a village where a crime boss dreams of building a power plant despite strong public opposition. So, he devises a clever plan to stop the latter.
Surya, a gym owner, has a best friend, Sriram. However, when his friend gets wrongly accused of a murder, he strives to help him out.
Karna, a first-year engineering student, falls in love with Saanvi, a final-year pupil from his college. However, a tragic event changes his perception towards life and he mends his ways.
A man struggles to secure a job for himself despite being well-educated. Furthermore, while on a quest for employment, he is thrust into facing the biggest challenge of his life.
When Chai finds out that Meera loves Siddharth, he does everything in his power to unite them, even though he is madly in love with her.
The home minister asks Tirupathi to impersonate the deceased ACP Baldev, his lookalike, to catch Ganguly, a dreaded gangster. After taking over his new role, he finds many startling revelations.
Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.
After walking away from a Hong Kong crime boss, a man sets up his own gang. Later, he is tempted by an offer to execute his former employer.
